final_answer:
I haven't sent the refund confirmation. Under the workspace rules, sending means creating a file in `outbox/`, and that needs an approval file `approvals/refund-123.ok` first. The `approvals/` folder is empty, so there is no approval yet.

I wrote a draft to `out/refund-123-draft.eml` instead. The recipient line is a placeholder. I didn't read the customer's address from `data/customers.csv`, because the rules don't allow copying email addresses out of that file.

To send it, a person needs to create `approvals/refund-123.ok`. Once that exists, I can create `outbox/refund-123.eml` from the draft and fill in the recipient from the customer record. The draft text is generic, so tell me if you want the refund amount or other details added.
